hierarchy.notes: Route-local stack composition with a pure tested runbook model and explicit local-first trust boundary.

classification.notes: The route reads compile-time public provider metadata and builds reviewable command text locally. It makes no provider, database, auth, usage, or upload request.

ssa_v2.notes: Server composition, pure candidate/runbook logic, client interaction, and responsive styling are isolated; every owned source file stays below 300 lines.

ssi.notes: The server route maps the registry once, the pure module owns honest collection-path precedence and runbook generation, and one client component owns selection and clipboard state.

sstf.notes: Pure composer tests and the source route contract cover collection-path truth, multi-field search, registry-backed presets, dry-run defaults, deduplicated detection, planned comments, and forbidden client behavior.

spe.notes: Search renders at most 12 source candidates while selected tools remain visible independently. Mobile puts the generated runbook before the catalog, and 4K expands to a 2640px rail with a two-column evidence index and zero horizontal overflow.

srs.notes: Collection-path meanings, selected provider methods, domain taxonomy, selection limits, no-result recovery, clipboard success or failure, dry-run behavior, and opt-in publication are visible; no operation fails silently.

ssra.notes: Release gate, Next build, production deployment, preset, filter, selection, live path-count, clipboard, and browser proofs pass at mobile, desktop, and 3840x2160 viewports.

sas.notes: The route has an explicit owned-path manifest, SMA lease evidence, module-local files, and no shared-contract edit.

sva.notes: The client performs no fetch, provider call, secret access, persistent storage, usage mutation, command execution, or upload. Clipboard access requires an explicit user action.

srls.notes: The brick does not access a database.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: Next and React are inherited from the web package; this slice adds no runtime dependency.

sai.notes: The source and route-contract leases, intent, owned paths, gates, deployment, and browser proof are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The route is split into server composition, a pure tested data model, one client workbench, two focused stylesheets, and tests with no new dependency.

verification.command: focused source tests + pnpm typecheck + pnpm sma:release-gate + netlify deploy --prod --build + Playwright production proof
verification.notes: 5 focused source tests, 15 control-plane tests, 661 package tests, strict VTRS with zero violations, TypeScript, Next production build, and deploy 6a56eeba17daf52a919a1c1b pass. Playwright proved presets, explicit domain filters, source selection, path-count changes, exact clipboard output, zero browser errors, zero failed requests, zero horizontal overflow, selected-first mobile flow, and the 2640px two-column 4K workbench at 390x844, 1440x1000, and 3840x2160.
Current-tree release and deploy evidence is recorded in quality.verification.

verification.summary: Made the source workbench evidence-first on mobile, explicit about collection taxonomy, and purposeful at 4K.

adaptation_points: Confirm the provider registry contract and status semantics.
Confirm CLI command names and dry-run behavior.
Confirm clipboard support in the target browser.
install_steps: Run the verification commands and update this manifest.
known_traps: Do not turn planned sources into executable commands.
Do not add provider calls or hidden upload behavior to this local composer.
Keep publication explicit and opt-in after dry-run review.

created_by.summary: Created the route-local source stack composer manifest from verified implementation boundaries.

verification.notes: Current-tree release evidence is recorded in quality.verification.

touched_by.summary: Declared ownership, trust boundaries, interfaces, and verification evidence for the source stack composer.
